name: fsi_country_score
description: Fragile States Index score and rank for ONE country — a country-fragility risk measure (12 cohesion/economic/political/social indicators rolled into one 0-120 score; higher = more fragile). Published annually by The Fund for Peace. PREFER for "how fragile is <country>", "<country> fragile states index", "state fragility risk for <country>", or as background context on a country before/alongside news-event data (complements gdelt). Pass a country name (e.g. "Somalia", "Brazil", "United States" — common aliases like "USA"/"DRC"/"Ivory Coast" are accepted).

name: fsi_ranking
description: Rank countries by Fragile States Index score — the N most fragile or N most stable countries in one call, with rank and score. PREFER for "most fragile countries", "most stable/least fragile countries", "top 10 failed states", "which countries are at highest state-fragility risk". direction defaults to "most_fragile".

limit.description: How many countries to return (default 10, max 50).

direction.description: Which end of the ranking to return. Default "most_fragile".
